title: Faces of a rectangular box
observableEvidence: Counts the number of faces, edges, or vertices of a rectangular solid without a picture, reasoning from its structure.
prompt: A rectangular box (a rectangular prism) has a different length, width, and height. How many faces does the box have in total?

figure.svgMarkup: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 300" role="img"><rect width="500" height="300" fill="#ffffff"/><polygon points="120,105 315,105 390,55 195,55" fill="#d9ece8" stroke="#2c534f" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/><polygon points="315,105 390,55 390,190 315,240" fill="#c5ddd8" stroke="#2c534f" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="120" y="105" width="195" height="135" fill="#eaf4f2" stroke="#2c534f" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="120" y1="105" x2="195" y2="55" stroke="#2c534f" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="120" y1="240" x2="195" y2="190" stroke="#77756e" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 7"/><line x1="195" y1="55" x2="195" y2="190" stroke="#77756e" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 7"/><line x1="195" y1="190" x2="390" y2="190" stroke="#77756e" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 7"/></svg>
figure.altText: A perspective drawing of a rectangular prism. The front, top, and right faces are visible. Dashed lines indicate the three hidden back edges.
figure.caption: Rectangular prism with visible and hidden edges.

solutionRepresentation: A rectangular prism has 3 pairs of opposite, congruent faces: top/bottom, front/back, left/right, totaling 6 faces.
solutionMethod: Count the pairs of opposite faces on a rectangular prism: top-bottom, front-back, and left-right.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept with or without the word 'faces'.

hintSteps.prompt: Picture a box like a shoebox and imagine touching each flat surface one at a time.
hintSteps.question: How many flat surfaces (faces) does a shoebox have on top and bottom together?

hintSteps.prompt: A box also has a front, a back, a left side, and a right side.
hintSteps.question: How many pairs of opposite faces does a rectangular box have in total?

hintSteps.prompt: Since each of the 3 pairs contributes 2 faces, multiply the number of pairs by 2.
hintSteps.question: What is 3 pairs times 2 faces per pair?

review.originalityStatement: Original scenario written for this repository, inspired only by the general Math Kangaroo skill type of 3D-solid reasoning; no problem or diagram reproduced from any contest archive.

accessibilityNotes: Show the prism together with its complete text alternative; dashed hidden edges must not be the only way hidden structure is conveyed.
accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: A rectangular box has a different length, width, and height. Find the total number of flat faces the box has.
